what: When text·photos reach 85% of the screen, they sharpen from 10px blur and transparent in .8s (in place, no movement, once). With on: load, it starts right after attach once the delay passes — used for the first-screen logo · art · menu appearing over 2s like fog lifting

options.on: If 「load」, it starts right away without waiting to be visible
options.scale: Initial size, default 1 (unchanged) — 1.05 shrinks into place from slightly large, becoming sharp
options.bright: Starting brightness, default 1 (as is) — 1.4 returns together from a brightly washed-out state to normal brightness (video of the original site)
options.from: Initial opacity, default 0 — frost is .3 (waits lightly blurred)
options.y: Initial downward offset (px), default 0 — a photo rises from 30 and comes into focus
options.end: End blur (px), default 0 (fully clears) — at 1 it stays slightly blurred (watercolor decoration)
options.fade: Length in seconds for the transparency to clear, same as the default dur — transparency clears before blur (Brand 1.6s blur · .8s transparency)
